boundary: Tiny original CPU arithmetic only. No torch/model/data/GPU/API dependencies, no official assignment implementation, no claim of runtime or model-quality replication.

cases.purpose: Check merge equivalence, rank-of-increment distinction, and analytic/finite-difference gradient path.
cases.definition: h=W0*x+s*B*(A*x); scalar loss=g dot h. Treat W0 fixed, use central differences for A/B/x if desired.
cases.recommended_tolerance: Float64 central differences epsilon1e-6; absolute error <=1e-6. Exact hand arithmetic equality is not a BF16 bitwise claim.

cases.purpose: Check first-step gradient asymmetry and all-zero dead branch; optional nullspace counterexample.
additional_checks: Set both A and B to zero: both factor gradients are zero.
Keep A=[1,2], B=0 but use x=[2,-1]: Ax=0, so the first B gradient is also zero despite nonzero g. Random/zero initialization only usually yields a nonzero first B gradient.

cases.purpose: Separate weight bits, first/second-level scale bits, adapter optimizer states and MiB units.
cases.assumptions: Full tuning or adapters use2-byte params+2-byte grads+4-byte master+8-byte Adam states. Frozen LoRA base uses2-byte params only; NF4_DQ base ideal full blocks; exclude codebook/mean/fixed metadata, padding/alignment, unquantized modules, activations, attention, dequant workspace and allocator overhead. Not a peak-memory measurement.

cases.purpose: Demonstrate that post-merge requantization changes a linear mapping without any model dependency.
cases.definition: Round merged weight to nearest multiple of0.5; values avoid ties.
cases.boundary: Illustrative scalar quantizer, not NF4 implementation or a claim about measured QLoRA errors.
